description: R shape set of the conv-wrw test plan: real model backward-weights geometries picked from the dnn-benchmarking convolution corpus (one median graph per wrw behaviour signature per level ceiling, every model at least once). See docs/test-plans/convolution-wrw.md section 3.3.

source.note: each graph is the object <graph_key>.json of the store; the key is the sha256 of the geometry, so a pick cannot change under a later store update

selection: behaviour signature = conv_wrw_plan.signature() (rank, group class, C/G class, K/G class, filter class, stride class, padding class, reduction and output class); per signature the median-FLOP graph inside each level ceiling (standard <= 200 MFLOP and 16 MiB, comprehensive <= 8 GFLOP and 64 MiB, full <= 120 GFLOP and 1 GiB); every model at least once in standard or comprehensive; a graph sits in the lowest level that picked it
